The Detect Target Using Spectra tool computes a matching score for each pixel in an input raster based on how well the pixel's spectrum matches the target spectra defined by an input spectral signature file.

The multiband raster containing the target pixels to be detected.

The file type of the input spectral signature file.

The spectral signature file that contains the target spectra.

The method used to compute the matching scores between the input raster and the spectral signature file.

Specifies whether the spectra are normalized, which can be done using an image or reference data. If unchecked, the spectra are not normalized. If checked, the spectra are normalized.

The name of the layer containing the matching score raster that is created and displayed.

The type of output that will be created. The output can be a tiled imagery layer or a dynamic imagery layer.

The name of the folder in My content where the result will be saved.
